claim_comment: Closing the smallest provider composition mount only after the root default remains exactly production, memory-fabric is an explicit one-dependency feature, disabled resolution excludes every provider crate, enabled resolution reaches one product-owned registry, that registry constructs one finite fabric plus one Native adapter without side effects, and no concrete adapter type appears in host or public transport crates.

checks.name: TraceDecay compiles with explicit Memory Fabric
canonical provider Rust bindings remain generated
working tree has no whitespace damage

acceptance_criteria: Default build remains exactly the existing production feature graph and resolves no provider registry or adapter.
Explicit memory-fabric activation constructs one bounded MemoryFabric through one product-owned registry path and registers one Native adapter at an explicit revision and mode.
No concrete provider type or registry dependency leaks into host-specific integration, CLI, MCP, dashboard API, SDK, or any root source outside runtime_ports.rs.
Generated provider contracts remain the authority and all API, fabric, Native, dependency, and upstream-footprint gates remain green.
close_reason: Added one explicit default-off Memory Fabric feature, one product-owned Native composition registry, and one thin root mount with machine-checked isolation and unchanged default behavior.
close_comment: Evidence: tracedecay-memory-provider-registry depends only on the provider API, fabric, and Native adapter; compose_native_memory creates finite fabric limits, validates a positive registration revision, constructs NativeProvider behind Arc<dyn MemoryProvider>, and registers exactly one tracedecay.native provider without opening a store, starting a worker, reading environment/configuration, or handshaking. Root Cargo keeps default exactly [production], keeps production free of memory-fabric, and maps memory-fabric only to the optional registry dependency. runtime_ports.rs contains the sole feature-gated root delegate and names neither NativeProvider nor the Native crate. The focused verifier rejects default activation, non-optional wiring, concrete adapter imports, and registry leaks; dependency policy makes the registry the sole narrow concrete composition owner; disabled/enabled cargo-tree receipts are asserted during materialization; dedicated CI compiles both root graphs and tests the registry.
